title: Tenma Saki — Old Piano Trio〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello! We have a reservation under the name “Tenma”♪

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Hehe. We've been waiting for you.
Your table is right this way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't realize you'd gone through the trouble of making a reservation, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I had a shift yesterday, so I just asked then.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Your order will be right out.
Please let me know if you need anything else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪ We'll be right here!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You seem to be in an awfully good mood today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because it's been forever since the three of us last went out together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I've really been looking forward to hearing about what happened during Shibuya Instrument Day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. I've been wondering as well, after Saki told me about how you'd been asked to help with customers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, why don't we jump right in with that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First, my customer service skills. After I agreed to lend a hand, Shiraishi helped me practice interacting with customers. I wouldn't have been able to get through that day without her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The first actual customers I helped were an elderly couple hoping to learn to play a new instrument together...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that's when a boy came over to try playing the trumpet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He dreamt of playing the trumpet, but struggled to produce a steady tone. So much so that he was ready to give up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (His dream...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that boy came over to the demo area to overcome said issue, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's also what I initially suspected.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As luck would have it, two other friends of ours were the ones who'd brought him over. We actually ended up practicing together as a form of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I still can't play, despite all the help you guys are giving me...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I don't think I'm cut out for this, after all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I felt just as frustrated as you are at the moment. Every time I failed, I felt like crying, because it was a reminder of my lack of skill and talent.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't remember how many times I wanted to give up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, after a year or two of practicing, my sound began improving.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But that made me so happy...
Even though I still had to endure some very hard practices, I couldn't stop playing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And each time I put in an honest effort, my music changed for the better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I could play even more beautifully than I had imagined.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If any part of you still wishes to produce beautiful music, then I implore you to not give up here.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Hey, let's go shopping already!
I've got my eye on some cute clothes.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Sure, but what about your homework?
Don't come crying to me when the teacher scolds you for not doing it.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: No fair...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: (When am I gonna get to have fun...?)

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: I have a letter addressed to one Ms. Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: (Who sent this? Ichi...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Letter
rows.Line: Happy Everyday ♡ Airi Momoi

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
H-Happy Everyday...?
Is this a reply to my fan letter?

rows.Speaker: Letter
rows.Line:
Dear Saki Tenma,
Thanks for sending me that letter♪ I thought your handwriting was so cute that I'm sort of trying to copy it now!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wow.
A reply from THE Airi Momoi...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that line she says as Happy Everyday was originally just her ad-libbing?! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, there's a second page.)

rows.Speaker: Letter
rows.Line: I can't imagine just how hard it must be for you to be stuck in the hospital the way you said.

rows.Speaker: Letter
rows.Line: Not being able to go to school, see your friends, go shopping or hang out...

rows.Speaker: Letter
rows.Line:
But,
I don't want you to give up.

rows.Speaker: Letter
rows.Line: To make sure that you don't, I'm gonna do my absolute best to bring as much courage, cheer and hope to you as I can.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...and the boy was able to figure out how to play the trumpet the way he always wanted.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that's incredible! The boy himself deserves praise, but you got him to the finish line, Toya! With an unfamiliar instrument no less!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I just didn't want him to give up, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that probably played a super duper extra huge role.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because it's so easy to only think negative thoughts when things aren't going well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But you kept his hopes alive.
You were able to get him to play the way he wanted!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's right! In the eyes of that boy, you're a superhero!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I am...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And when he becomes a super famous professional musician, he's gonna say, “I'm standing here today because of that young man.” I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It'd be quite an honor if that were to happen.
